faq.headline: Questions teams ask before buying
faq.subheadline: Don't see your question? Real engineers reply at hi@helix.app within four hours during business days.

items.question: Does Helix actually decline meetings on my behalf?
items.answer: Only with your explicit consent, and only when it matches a focus rule you defined. Default is 'suggest decline + draft reply' — you approve. The auto-decline mode is opt-in per rule.

items.question: What calendars work with Helix?
items.answer: Google Calendar and Outlook (Microsoft 365). Apple iCloud is on the roadmap for Q3. CalDAV self-hosted: planned, no timeline.

items.question: Can I switch plans later?
items.answer: Up or down any time. Prorated to the day. Cancel from your dashboard in two clicks, no email exit ritual.

items.question: How is this different from Reclaim or Clockwise?
items.answer: Reclaim optimizes your time; Helix protects it. Clockwise smooths out meetings across teams; Helix puts a sharper edge on individual focus rules. You can run all three; we'd rather you didn't need to.

items.question: Do you offer a free tier?
items.answer: Not currently. Solo is $19/mo with a real 14-day trial — long enough to feel the difference. We'd rather charge fairly than dilute the experience with an underpowered free tier.

items.question: Can I self-host?
items.answer: The core scheduler is open-source under Apache 2.0. The brief generator, integrations, and admin UI are hosted. Scale plan includes a self-hosted control plane license if you need everything on-prem.
